criteria.evidence: Opens by saying skipping comes from the model judging it doesn't need the tool, and discusses tool_choice auto vs forced, and tempting situations; but it doesn't explicitly trace the decision boundary (e.g., inspecting where/why the model decides) as a step, only a pattern comparison in item 6.

Item 6 asks to collect 10-20 failing queries and compare patterns, and the closing asks for framework, tool, and an example; but this evidence-gathering is placed last, after five lists of changes, rather than before changing anything.
Recommends prompt/description edits, tool_choice API setting, and simple code checks; no new frameworks are introduced, and it even asks which framework the user is using.
